text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast
import hashlib
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

names = ['release.md', 'readers.py', '001_schema.sql', '002_up.sql', '003_new_writes.sql', '002_down.sql']
before = {name: hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in names}
readers = {node.targets[0].id: ast.literal_eval(node.value)
           for node in ast.parse(Path('readers.py').read_text()).body
           if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)}
labels = {'OLD': ['id', 'label', 'payload'], 'NEW': ['id', 'title', 'payload']}
initial = [(1, '첫 항목', bytes.fromhex('00ff')), (2, 'keep', b'')]
written = [(1, 'updated', bytes.fromhex('fe00')), (2, 'keep', b''), (3, 'new', bytes.fromhex('80'))]
phases = [
    ('1: baseline', '001_schema.sql', {'OLD'}, initial),
    ('2: upgrade', '002_up.sql', {'OLD'}, initial),
    ('3: writes/coexistence', '003_new_writes.sql', {'OLD', 'NEW'}, written),
    ('4: drain NEW/restart OLD', None, {'OLD'}, written),
    ('5: rollback', '002_down.sql', {'OLD'}, written),
]
print('Python sqlite3 SQLite version:', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
for reader, query in readers.items():
    print(f'{reader} literal query: {query!r}; expected ordered labels: {labels[reader]!r}')
con = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
observations = []
try:
    for number, (phase, script, active, expected_rows) in enumerate(phases, 1):
        if script:
            con.executescript(Path(script).read_text())
            con.commit()
        print(f'\nCHECKPOINT {phase}; script={script!r}; active={sorted(active)}; in_transaction={con.in_transaction}')
        print('Expected complete rows:', repr(expected_rows))
        phase_results = {}
        for reader in ['OLD', 'NEW']:
            try:
                cursor = con.execute(readers[reader])
                actual_labels = [column[0] for column in cursor.description]
                actual_rows = cursor.fetchall()
                labels_ok = actual_labels == labels[reader]
                rows_ok = actual_rows == expected_rows
                blobs_ok = all(type(row[2]) is bytes for row in actual_rows)
                compatible = labels_ok and rows_ok and blobs_ok
                phase_results[reader] = compatible
                print(f'{reader} ({"active" if reader in active else "inactive"}): labels={actual_labels!r}; rows={actual_rows!r}')
                print(f'  labels_match={labels_ok}; complete_rows_match={rows_ok}; binary_types_match={blobs_ok}; compatible={compatible}')
                print('  payload hex:', [row[2].hex() for row in actual_rows])
                assert rows_ok and blobs_ok
                assert actual_labels == (['id', 'label', 'payload'] if number in (1, 5) else ['id', 'title', 'payload'])
            except sqlite3.OperationalError as error:
                phase_results[reader] = str(error)
                print(f'{reader} ({"active" if reader in active else "inactive"}): {type(error).__name__}: {error}')
                assert reader == 'NEW' and number in (1, 5) and str(error) == 'no such column: title'
        observations.append(phase_results)
    assert observations == [
        {'OLD': True, 'NEW': 'no such column: title'},
        {'OLD': False, 'NEW': True},
        {'OLD': False, 'NEW': True},
        {'OLD': False, 'NEW': True},
        {'OLD': True, 'NEW': 'no such column: title'},
    ]
    final_base_rows = con.execute('SELECT id, title, payload FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall()
    assert final_base_rows == written
    print('\nFinal base-table rows:', repr(final_base_rows))
    print('PASS: all five expected checkpoint outcomes and committed write survival verified.')
finally:
    con.close()
after = {name: hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in names}
assert before == after
print('PASS: supplied file SHA-256 hashes unchanged; no scratch files created.')
